title: Image Canvas
emptyTitle: Infinite canvas, create as you go
emptyHint: Type a prompt below to start generating images. Drag the background to pan, scroll to zoom.
promptPlaceholder: Describe the image you want to generate…
promptHint: Enter to generate · Shift + Enter for newline · attach a reference image to edit
referenceNotImage: Reference must be an image file
referenceFromNode: Set as reference. The result will be linked to this card.
clearConfirmDescription: All nodes on the canvas will be removed. This action cannot be undone.
pointerModePan: Pan mode (scroll to zoom, middle-drag to pan)
pointerModeSelect: Marquee mode (drag the background to select)
minimapHint: Click or drag to jump to a region
assetsEmpty: No assets yet. Generated images will appear here.
assetLocateHint: Click to locate and select this asset
regenerateHint: Adjust the prompt and regenerate with the original references and parameters. The result will be linked to the source image.
compareHint: Drag the divider to inspect differences
editorCropDragHint: Drag the crop box to move it, or drag an edge or corner to resize
nodePreviewHint: Click to enlarge, right-click to copy or save
copyPromptFailed: Copy failed, please select and copy manually.
downloadFailed: Download failed, please try again later.
noImageModelsHint: No image generation models are available. Please contact the administrator to enable image generation capability.
needLogin: Your session has expired, please sign in again.
editReferenceRequired: This model only supports image editing. Attach a reference image before sending.
editUnsupported: This model does not support image editing, reference images cannot be used.
generationUnsupported: The current model does not support image generation.
chatCapabilityRequired: This model generates images through a Chat route, but its configuration is missing the Chat capability. Enable both Chat and Image Generation capabilities.
conversationCreateFailed: Failed to create canvas conversation, please try again later.
uploadFailed: Reference image upload failed, please try again later.
generateFailed: Generation failed, please try again later.
noImageOutput: The model returned no image. Check the raw response.
moderationBlocked: Content was blocked by safety policy.
importInvalid: This JSON file is not a valid canvas project.
shortcutPan: Hold Space and drag to pan
shortcutModes: Press V for select, press H for pan
structureTipTitle: Frames carry content; Sections divide chapters
structureTipDescription: Nodes and decorations whose centers are inside a Frame are carried automatically and move with it. Sections only mark chapter areas, so their contents stay in place when moved.
